reason: Motion Pro Max is an agent skill pack for planning, implementing, and reviewing interface animations through engine routing, scene recipes, quality gates, and independent review; the README states it is not an automatically executing harness.

summaries.zh: 面向编码智能体的界面动效工程技能包，用于选择动效方案、生成实现配方并依据质量门进行审查。
summaries.en: An agent skill pack for planning, implementing, and reviewing interface motion through engine selection, scene recipes, and quality gates.

capabilities: Provides agent guidance for motion-design decisions and implementation
Routes animation work among CSS, Framer Motion, and GSAP
Provides scene recipes, implementation templates, and motion quality gates
Performs an independent five-dimension motion review of generated work
